set.body: Normative plan: docs/plans/neuroarchive-dataset-bridge.md. Deliver a minimal, source-blind bridge that reuses DatasetError, FmriDataset, DataSelection, DatasetIndex, DatasetRunQuery, DatasetMetadata, and DatasetRunPartition. Add checked FmriDataset construction, JVM LNA and NeuroArchive Zarr composers with honest timing asymmetry, provenance as a metadata value, checked zero-copy indexed run views, coordinate/window selection extensions, and segmented group/concatenate/reduce operations. Completion requires all child slices closed, JVM and Scala.js gates passing where applicable, downstream gates passing, testAll attempted at exact tip, and docs/module relations synchronized. Forbidden scope: parallel error, acquisition, handle/capability, study-index, selection, or projection algebras.
set.title: EPIC: Seamless NeuroArchive and FmriDataset composition
